description: Helper utility functions for managing notes, categories, downloads, backups, UI interactions, and clipboard operations in a note-taking application.

methods.name: getActiveNote
methods.description: Finds and returns the active note from a list based on activeNoteId.

methods.name: getShortUuid
methods.description: Returns the first 6 characters of a UUID.

methods.name: getActiveNoteFromShortUuid
methods.description: Finds a note by matching the start of its ID with a short UUID.

methods.name: getActiveCategory
methods.description: Finds and returns the active category from a list based on activeCategoryId.

methods.name: getNoteTitle
methods.description: Extracts a concise title from note text, removing markdown headers and whitespace.

methods.name: noteWithFrontmatter
methods.description: Generates markdown frontmatter for a note, including title, creation, and update timestamps.

methods.name: downloadNotes
methods.description: Downloads one or multiple notes as markdown files or a zip archive.

methods.name: backupNotes
methods.description: Creates a JSON backup of notes and categories and triggers download.

methods.name: newNote
methods.description: Creates a new note object with unique ID and timestamps.

methods.name: newNoteHandlerHelper
methods.description: Handles creation of a new note, folder swapping, and UI updates based on current state.

methods.name: shouldOpenContextMenu
methods.description: Determines if a click element should open a context menu based on its classes.

methods.name: getWebsiteTitle
methods.description: Returns the website title string based on active folder and category.

methods.name: determineAppClass
methods.description: Returns CSS class string for app container based on theme and folder.

methods.name: determineCategoryClass
methods.description: Returns CSS class string for category item based on dragging and active state.

methods.name: debounceEvent
methods.description: Creates a debounced version of a function to limit invocation rate.

methods.name: isDraftNote
methods.description: Checks if a note is a draft (empty and not in scratchpad).

methods.name: getDayJsLocale
methods.description: Attempts to load and return the locale string for dayjs, defaults to 'en'.

methods.name: getNoteBarConf
methods.description: Returns configuration for note sidebar based on active folder.

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies provided text to system clipboard.
